stemMd: If a proposal is approved, it is funded. If it is funded, work begins. Work has not begun. Which conclusion follows?

options.label: B
options.textMd: The proposal was approved but unfunded.

explanationMd: The two conditionals combine to give approval implies work begins. The absence of work therefore rules out approval under the stated rules. It also rules out funding, but says nothing about other proposals or later changes.

distractorRationale.b: Approval would imply funding and work.
distractorRationale.c: The premises concern this proposal only.
distractorRationale.d: The premises do not establish all future conditions.
